FOUNDATION_BOOK_1.overview: Foundations Book I introduces the basic structure, participants, language and mechanics of the stock market.
topics: What stocks and stock exchanges represent
How market participants, prices, bids, asks and orders interact
Foundational risk awareness and responsible market observation
FOUNDATION_BOOK_1.scope: Beginner foundations; not a collection of trade alerts or a promise of profitability.

FOUNDATION_BOOK_2.overview: Foundations Book II develops the ability to interpret market information instead of relying on hindsight.
topics: Reading price movement, volume and chart context
Identifying trends, important levels and evidence of liquidity
Separating observable market facts from interpretation
FOUNDATION_BOOK_2.scope: Builds on Book I and prepares for structured trading decisions in Book III.

FOUNDATION_BOOK_3.overview: Foundations Book III connects basic market knowledge and chart reading to a documented decision process.
topics: Preparing an evidence-based trading plan and considering risk
Defining setups, invalidation, position sizing and review
Recognizing when a NO TRADE decision is appropriate
FOUNDATION_BOOK_3.scope: Develops judgment and risk planning; does not promise trade outcomes.

DAY_TRADING_BOOK_1.overview: An introductory day-trading workflow focused on observation, planning, execution discipline and risk.
topics: Developing a repeatable intraday preparation and review routine
Identifying session context, liquidity and potential market setups
Thinking through risk controls, execution and journal review
DAY_TRADING_BOOK_1.scope: Recorded as in development in the existing book catalog. The owner controls publication and availability.

READING_THE_TAPE.overview: A guide to interpreting Time & Sales, Level II and the limits of modern order-flow evidence.
topics: Reading prints, quotes, bid/ask dynamics and displayed depth
Understanding spread, liquidity, order-size changes and tape context
Avoiding false certainty from displayed orders and historical order-flow patterns
READING_THE_TAPE.scope: Recorded as in development in the existing book catalog. The owner controls publication and availability.
